scenarios.notes: Reached Jan 1991 (12 months executed). Score 100 to 120, approval 74 to 65. Did not do K1 replay.

friction.expected: Click by label opens the code box
friction.happened: Label click reported failure while globe was moving; a coordinate tap worked. Box appears below the button and is easy to miss

friction.expected: Tapping the option title selects it
friction.happened: Tapping the heading did nothing; only tapping the picture or the Accept cabinet pick button selected. Unsure the card is a control
Call them quietly says free but the result says at a cost: Approval -3; the cost sat under +1 more

friction.expected: See the crisis (Corruption scandal) on the map screen
friction.happened: Only a line 1 crisis on the cabinet pick and a terse Crisis answer card; I could not read what the scandal was without going back to the desk
Opening the Recommended list shrinks the globe to a small ball
Report said Iran view warmed to -69; mission strip said now -89 (and -75 to -89 in the debrief after a Court Iran order). I do not know which is right and that is a deal-breaker for cause and effect

friction.where: Month 4 and 5 quiet-month desk, advisors suggest
friction.happened: Cards collapsed into 1-character-wide columns with vertical letters; Full desk view is fine
Tension 34 to 48 in one month with the Iraq sanctions crisis; no explanation where I looked
Mulroney, Roh Tae-woo and Andreotti all say We heard you. Let us keep this line open; repeated Court Iran / Promise full support every month, I felt I was on rails
Calls with Italy and Turkey show an election projection (377 seats majority won)
Sample sentence is about Donetsk and Kramatorsk in a 1990 game; names unknown to a 1990 persona
An Outbreak with a vaccine effort option in 1990 and a US-Iraq nuclear threshold crisis; Iraq nuclear program is a stretch
The group accept button is so easy I stopped reading advice; General strike and Outbreak were answered by the cabinet pick without my reading them

bugs.actual: Text one letter per line, cards 60px wide

bugs.title: Mission strip Iran number disagrees with the report
bugs.actual: Mission strip shows Iran -75 to -89 while detail shows -74 to -69

steps: Vote for sanctions on Iraq in month 6

steps: Accept a call from Italy or Turkey

suggestions.what: Show the numbers of the mission goal the same everywhere and say which rival it is
Add a Replay this month with another choice button after a debrief
suggestions.goal_served: K1 replay a crisis with the opposite choice

suggestions.what: Show the crisis text in Map mode, not only its answer
Give each leader own phrasing for the same call
suggestions.goal_served: K2 world behaves like it plausibly could

suggestions.what: Explain tension jumps in one line in the debrief

delight: Debrief cards show before and after numbers with the leader quote (Kim Il Sung, Gorbachev, Saddam); the era names are right (Kaifu, Roh Tae-woo, Mitterrand, Ozal)
Seed code reproduced the exact 1990 Bush opening
See everything: Diplomacy page explains cause and effect well

fun.reason: Good first month, but accept-all months repeated Court Iran and calls.

clarity.reason: Debrief is clear; mission numbers contradict, Map mode hides crisis text.

visual.reason: Handsome scenes and paper; vertical-letter bug and wrong call art.

feels_like_a_game.reason: Reads like a briefing sim, which suits me, but I clicked accept most months.

agency.reason: Never blocked, but my choices mattered little in quiet months and pending orders often unspent at cap 6.

realism.reason: Names and leaders right, but Iraq nuclear program, outbreak and 16-vote UN board broke it.

replay.reason: Seed codes are good; no way to compare a replayed crisis inside the session.

recommend.reason: I would recommend it to a history friend with caveats on plausibility.

verbatim: I like the debriefs. I do not like not knowing whether Iran is at -69 or -89. A sanctions vote in 1990 with a clandestine Iraqi nuclear program is a stretch, and an outbreak with a vaccine in 1990 is silly.
